"""Orders."""

import re


def _reference(prefix, number, customer):
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", customer.lower()).strip("-")
    if not slug:
        slug = "anonymous"
    if len(slug) > 12:
        slug = slug[:12].rstrip("-")
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}-{slug}"


def new_order(number, customer, lines):
    total = sum(quantity * price for _, quantity, price in lines)
    return {
        "reference": _reference("ORD", number, customer),
        "customer": customer,
        "lines": list(lines),
        "total": round(total, 2),
    }
